text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the beginning of Taiki
Shuttle's
training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She was so happy to have a trainer of
her own. I
have to give it everything I've
got!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But when I arrive at the meet-up spot,
Taiki is
nowhere to be found.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thirty minutes pass. I take out my
phone, hoping
to get in contact with
her, when suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I've been at the racecourse—figured the
races
were on from today. Sorry 'bout
that!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I'm just in time for training
though!
Ain't that grand!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Now that's a frown if I ever saw
one...
choice_data_list: That's totally across the line, you know.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I see what the problem is! Were ya
feelin' a little
lonely?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No need to deny it! It's tough bein' on
your own. I
know that feeling all too
well.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But don't ya worry! I won't leave ya
alone again!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So let's get to training! I can handle
whatever ya
throw at me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I swear to make up for all the time we
lost 'cause I
was late—trust me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as she pumps herself up for
training...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's one of my friends runnin'
over there!
Howdy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, she isn't able to focus for
more
than two seconds.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle is cheerful and
energetic—but it
looks like we may have
a bit of a bumpy road
ahead of us.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Woohoo! Today's training session was so
fun!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Sorry I kept runnin' off to go see all my
friends.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That regimen was just right for me.
I had so
much fun!
choice_data_list: Still, you managed to finish the whole routine.
Still, you were able to finish the routine.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I just about forgot! Trainer, would
ya mind
comin' along with me
somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a bright smile on her face, Taiki
Shuttle
takes me away.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: We're here! All right...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What kinda milk do ya want, Trainer?
Your
choice!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That's right! ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
When you're down for a fight, a glass of
milk'll
make ya right! That's my family
motto!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Milk is awesome! It draws out your true
power, so
ya can grow up big and
strong!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I drank a ton of milk, and just look how
big I got!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You should start drinkin' milk too and
unleash
your full power!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: For the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki is her usual energetic and
unpredictable
self, but I can tell she's
really serious about this.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Here's to victory!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, delicious! ♪ Nothin' like milk when
ya need
a power boost.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I bet my family back in Kentucky's out
milkin' the
cows like always, waiting for
me to make a name
for myself!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to give 'em some good news!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's do it!
choice_data_list: Let's make a huge splash together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki's debut race is approaching fast, so
we need
to double up on our training!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of us vow to do our best on the
road
ahead!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I shouldn't be kickin' back too much
at a time
like this.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All right, Trainer! Ready for what's up
next?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I've got more mottoes where that one
came from!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
When you're down for a fight, a glass of
milk'll
make ya right! Aaand...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Chow down on some big ol' steaks! Eat
as much as
you can take!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Now that you've got the memo, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If I want Taiki Shuttle to reach her goals,
I'll need
to match her energy! This
thought sticks with me
for the rest of the
day.
